_doc: Batch m03 (medium creatures, sonnet generic pass). Same format as overrides.json.

ghost-slug/f:b0.note: puddle lunge: ripple rings off a puddle (best guess)

ghost-slug/f:b1.note: cave-mouth chill: cold breath mist puff, differs from the two slashes

ghost-slug/f:b3.note: slime shapeshift: pale ooze drips, not a shock

giant-banded-snail/f:b0.note: gnaw is the action, leaf litter is the food: bite (best guess vs leaf)

giant-banded-snail/f:b1.note: barrel-shell crush: heavy bash, differs from Striped Roll slash

giant-banded-snail/f:u2.note: slime sheet: slimy drops, not a web

giant-banded-snail/f:b3.note: litter roll over: leaf litter spin

herring-gull/f:b0.note: scrap-snatch peck: bite (peck is a beak action)

herring-gull/f:u1.note: gull swoop: diving lance, differs from Screaming Swoop slash

tern-squadron/f:b3.note: annoyed break-away: sharp scatter, differs from Wing Wheel puff

skua-raider/f:u1.note: beak jab: bite of the hooked bill, differs from Skua Stoop lance

skua-raider/f:u3.note: stealing in flight: snatch strands, differs from Loot-Grab Flight puff

cormorant-line/f:b0.note: post spear peck: bite, differs from Dive Spear lance

cormorant-line/f:u2.note: wing dry: water drops shaken off, differs from Line Shuffle puff

cormorant-line/f:u3.note: surfaced catch: fish gripped in hooked bill

booby-colony/f:u0.note: blue foot strut: bright display glints, differs from Rude Interruption puff

turkey-vulture/f:b3.note: thermal lift-off: rising heat shimmer, ember (best guess)

mountain-buzzard/f:b0.note: ridge hook peck: hooked beak, bite

mountain-buzzard/f:b3.note: ridgeline glide off: soft gliding ripples, differs from Ridge Circle puff

burrowing-owl/f:u1.note: dust spurt: kicked dust, bash dust blocks, differs from Ground Strike lance

snowy-owl-scout/f:b3.note: vanishing lift-off: snow glints fade, differs from Blank Perch puff
